### 🗂️ ./App.tsx

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { NavigationContainer, LinkingOptions } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { View, ActivityIndicator, Text } from 'react-native';
import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { supabase } from './src/services/supabase';
import AuthNavigator from './src/navigation/AuthNavigator';
import AppNavigator from './src/navigation/AppNavigator';
import { AuthStackParamList, AppStackParamList } from './src/navigation/types';

const prefix = Linking.createURL('/');

/**
 * @description
 * O componente raiz do aplicativo.
 * Suas responsabilidades são:
 * 1. Prover o contexto de Área Segura para toda a aplicação.
 * 2. Gerenciar o estado da sessão de autenticação.
 * 3. Configurar o deep linking para fluxos como a recuperação de senha.
 */
export default function App() {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    const {
      data: { subscription },
    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setSession(session);
      if (
        _event === 'SIGNED_OUT' ||
        _event === 'SIGNED_IN' ||
        _event === 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY'
      ) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  /**
   * @description
   * Configuração do Deep Linking para o React Navigation.
   * Conecta URLs (como as de e-mail) a telas específicas do aplicativo.
   */
  const linking: LinkingOptions<AuthStackParamList & AppStackParamList> = {
    prefixes: [prefix],
    config: {
      screens: {
        ResetPassword: 'reset-password',
      },
    },
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#3F83F8" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <NavigationContainer
        linking={linking}
        fallback={<Text>Carregando...</Text>}
      >
        {session && session.user ? <AppNavigator /> : <AuthNavigator />}
      </NavigationContainer>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}

```

```javascript
/* eslint-disable */
var jumpToCode = (function init() {
  // Classes of code we would like to highlight in the file view
  var missingCoverageClasses = ['.cbranch-no', '.cstat-no', '.fstat-no'];

  // Elements to highlight in the file listing view
  var fileListingElements = ['td.pct.low'];

  // We don't want to select elements that are direct descendants of another match
  var notSelector = ':not(' + missingCoverageClasses.join('):not(') + ') > '; // becomes `:not(a):not(b) > `

  // Selector that finds elements on the page to which we can jump
  var selector =
    fileListingElements.join(', ') +
    ', ' +
    notSelector +
    missingCoverageClasses.join(', ' + notSelector); // becomes `:not(a):not(b) > a, :not(a):not(b) > b`

  // The NodeList of matching elements
  var missingCoverageElements = document.querySelectorAll(selector);

  var currentIndex;

  function toggleClass(index) {
    missingCoverageElements.item(currentIndex).classList.remove('highlighted');
    missingCoverageElements.item(index).classList.add('highlighted');
  }

  function makeCurrent(index) {
    toggleClass(index);
    currentIndex = index;
    missingCoverageElements.item(index).scrollIntoView({
      behavior: 'smooth',
      block: 'center',
      inline: 'center',
    });
  }

  function goToPrevious() {
    var nextIndex = 0;
    if (typeof currentIndex !== 'number' || currentIndex === 0) {
      nextIndex = missingCoverageElements.length - 1;
    } else if (missingCoverageElements.length > 1) {
      nextIndex = currentIndex - 1;
    }

    makeCurrent(nextIndex);
  }

  function goToNext() {
    var nextIndex = 0;

    if (
      typeof currentIndex === 'number' &&
      currentIndex < missingCoverageElements.length - 1
    ) {
      nextIndex = currentIndex + 1;
    }

    makeCurrent(nextIndex);
  }

  return function jump(event) {
    if (
      document.getElementById('fileSearch') === document.activeElement &&
      document.activeElement != null
    ) {
      // if we're currently focused on the search input, we don't want to navigate
      return;
    }

    switch (event.which) {
      case 78: // n
      case 74: // j
        goToNext();
        break;
      case 66: // b
      case 75: // k
      case 80: // p
        goToPrevious();
        break;
    }
  };
})();
window.addEventListener('keydown', jumpToCode);
```

```css
body,
html {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  height: 100%;
}
body {
  font-family:
    Helvetica Neue,
    Helvetica,
    Arial;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #333;
}
.small {
  font-size: 12px;
}
*,
*:after,
*:before {
  -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
  -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
h1 {
  font-size: 20px;
  margin: 0;
}
h2 {
  font-size: 14px;
}
pre {
  font:
    12px/1.4 Consolas,
    'Liberation Mono',
    Menlo,
    Courier,
    monospace;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  -moz-tab-size: 2;
  -o-tab-size: 2;
  tab-size: 2;
}
a {
  color: #0074d9;
  text-decoration: none;
}
a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.strong {
  font-weight: bold;
}
.space-top1 {
  padding: 10px 0 0 0;
}
.pad2y {
  padding: 20px 0;
}
.pad1y {
  padding: 10px 0;
}
.pad2x {
  padding: 0 20px;
}
.pad2 {
  padding: 20px;
}
.pad1 {
  padding: 10px;
}
.space-left2 {
  padding-left: 55px;
}
.space-right2 {
  padding-right: 20px;
}
.center {
  text-align: center;
}
.clearfix {
  display: block;
}
.clearfix:after {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 0;
  clear: both;
  visibility: hidden;
}
.fl {
  float: left;
}
@media only screen and (max-width: 640px) {
  .col3 {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .hide-mobile {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

.quiet {
  color: #7f7f7f;
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.quiet a {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.fraction {
  font-family: Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #555;
  background: #e8e8e8;
  padding: 4px 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

div.path a:link,
div.path a:visited {
  color: #333;
}
table.coverage {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 10px 0 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

table.coverage td {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  vertical-align: top;
}
table.coverage td.line-count {
  text-align: right;
  padding: 0 5px 0 20px;
}
table.coverage td.line-coverage {
  text-align: right;
  padding-right: 10px;
  min-width: 20px;
}

table.coverage td span.cline-any {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0 5px;
  width: 100%;
}
.missing-if-branch {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 4px;
  background: #333;
  color: yellow;
}

.skip-if-branch {
  display: none;
  margin-right: 10px;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 4px;
  background: #ccc;
  color: white;
}
.missing-if-branch .typ,
.skip-if-branch .typ {
  color: inherit !important;
}
.coverage-summary {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
}
.coverage-summary tr {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #bbb;
}
.keyline-all {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
}
.coverage-summary td,
.coverage-summary th {
  padding: 10px;
}
.coverage-summary tbody {
  border: 1px solid #bbb;
}
.coverage-summary td {
  border-right: 1px solid #bbb;
}
.coverage-summary td:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}
.coverage-summary th {
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: normal;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.coverage-summary th.file {
  border-right: none !important;
}
.coverage-summary th.pct {
}
.coverage-summary th.pic,
.coverage-summary th.abs,
.coverage-summary td.pct,
.coverage-summary td.abs {
  text-align: right;
}
.coverage-summary td.file {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.coverage-summary td.pic {
  min-width: 120px !important;
}
.coverage-summary tfoot td {
}

.coverage-summary .sorter {
  height: 10px;
  width: 7px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 0.5em;
  background: url(sort-arrow-sprite.png) no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}
.coverage-summary .sorted .sorter {
  background-position: 0 -20px;
}
.coverage-summary .sorted-desc .sorter {
  background-position: 0 -10px;
}
.status-line {
  height: 10px;
}
/* yellow */
.cbranch-no {
  background: yellow !important;
  color: #111;
}
/* dark red */
.red.solid,
.status-line.low,
.low .cover-fill {
  background: #c21f39;
}
.low .chart {
  border: 1px solid #c21f39;
}
.highlighted,
.highlighted .cstat-no,
.highlighted .fstat-no,
.highlighted .cbranch-no {
  background: #c21f39 !important;
}
/* medium red */
.cstat-no,
.fstat-no,
.cbranch-no,
.cbranch-no {
  background: #f6c6ce;
}
/* light red */
.low,
.cline-no {
  background: #fce1e5;
}
/* light green */
.high,
.cline-yes {
  background: rgb(230, 245, 208);
}
/* medium green */
.cstat-yes {
  background: rgb(161, 215, 106);
}
/* dark green */
.status-line.high,
.high .cover-fill {
  background: rgb(77, 146, 33);
}
.high .chart {
  border: 1px solid rgb(77, 146, 33);
}
/* dark yellow (gold) */
.status-line.medium,
.medium .cover-fill {
  background: #f9cd0b;
}
.medium .chart {
  border: 1px solid #f9cd0b;
}
/* light yellow */
.medium {
  background: #fff4c2;
}

.cstat-skip {
  background: #ddd;
  color: #111;
}
.fstat-skip {
  background: #ddd;
  color: #111 !important;
}
.cbranch-skip {
  background: #ddd !important;
  color: #111;
}

span.cline-neutral {
  background: #eaeaea;
}

.coverage-summary td.empty {
  opacity: 0.5;
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #888;
}

.cover-fill,
.cover-empty {
  display: inline-block;
  height: 12px;
}
.chart {
  line-height: 0;
}
.cover-empty {
  background: white;
}
.cover-full {
  border-right: none !important;
}
pre.prettyprint {
  border: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}
.com {
  color: #999 !important;
}
.ignore-none {
  color: #999;
  font-weight: normal;
}

.wrapper {
  min-height: 100%;
  height: auto !important;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto -48px;
}
.footer,
.push {
  height: 48px;
}
```

### 🗂️ ./coverage/lcov-report/sorter.js

```javascript
/* eslint-disable */
var addSorting = (function () {
  'use strict';
  var cols,
    currentSort = {
      index: 0,
      desc: false,
    };

  // returns the summary table element
  function getTable() {
    return document.querySelector('.coverage-summary');
  }
  // returns the thead element of the summary table
  function getTableHeader() {
    return getTable().querySelector('thead tr');
  }
  // returns the tbody element of the summary table
  function getTableBody() {
    return getTable().querySelector('tbody');
  }
  // returns the th element for nth column
  function getNthColumn(n) {
    return getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th')[n];
  }

  function onFilterInput() {
    const searchValue = document.getElementById('fileSearch').value;
    const rows = document.getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0].children;

    // Try to create a RegExp from the searchValue. If it fails (invalid regex),
    // it will be treated as a plain text search
    let searchRegex;
    try {
      searchRegex = new RegExp(searchValue, 'i'); // 'i' for case-insensitive
    } catch (error) {
      searchRegex = null;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const row = rows[i];
      let isMatch = false;

      if (searchRegex) {
        // If a valid regex was created, use it for matching
        isMatch = searchRegex.test(row.textContent);
      } else {
        // Otherwise, fall back to the original plain text search
        isMatch = row.textContent
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchValue.toLowerCase());
      }

      row.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
    }
  }

  // loads the search box
  function addSearchBox() {
    var template = document.getElementById('filterTemplate');
    var templateClone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
    templateClone.getElementById('fileSearch').oninput = onFilterInput;
    template.parentElement.appendChild(templateClone);
  }

  // loads all columns
  function loadColumns() {
    var colNodes = getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th'),
      colNode,
      cols = [],
      col,
      i;

    for (i = 0; i < colNodes.length; i += 1) {
      colNode = colNodes[i];
      col = {
        key: colNode.getAttribute('data-col'),
        sortable: !colNode.getAttribute('data-nosort'),
        type: colNode.getAttribute('data-type') || 'string',
      };
      cols.push(col);
      if (col.sortable) {
        col.defaultDescSort = col.type === 'number';
        colNode.innerHTML = colNode.innerHTML + '<span class="sorter"></span>';
      }
    }
    return cols;
  }
  // attaches a data attribute to every tr element with an object
  // of data values keyed by column name
  function loadRowData(tableRow) {
    var tableCols = tableRow.querySelectorAll('td'),
      colNode,
      col,
      data = {},
      i,
      val;
    for (i = 0; i < tableCols.length; i += 1) {
      colNode = tableCols[i];
      col = cols[i];
      val = colNode.getAttribute('data-value');
      if (col.type === 'number') {
        val = Number(val);
      }
      data[col.key] = val;
    }
    return data;
  }
  // loads all row data
  function loadData() {
    var rows = getTableBody().querySelectorAll('tr'),
      i;

    for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
      rows[i].data = loadRowData(rows[i]);
    }
  }
  // sorts the table using the data for the ith column
  function sortByIndex(index, desc) {
    var key = cols[index].key,
      sorter = function (a, b) {
        a = a.data[key];
        b = b.data[key];
        return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
      },
      finalSorter = sorter,
      tableBody = document.querySelector('.coverage-summary tbody'),
      rowNodes = tableBody.querySelectorAll('tr'),
      rows = [],
      i;

    if (desc) {
      finalSorter = function (a, b) {
        return -1 * sorter(a, b);
      };
    }

    for (i = 0; i < rowNodes.length; i += 1) {
      rows.push(rowNodes[i]);
      tableBody.removeChild(rowNodes[i]);
    }

    rows.sort(finalSorter);

    for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
      tableBody.appendChild(rows[i]);
    }
  }
  // removes sort indicators for current column being sorted
  function removeSortIndicators() {
    var col = getNthColumn(currentSort.index),
      cls = col.className;

    cls = cls.replace(/ sorted$/, '').replace(/ sorted-desc$/, '');
    col.className = cls;
  }
  // adds sort indicators for current column being sorted
  function addSortIndicators() {
    getNthColumn(currentSort.index).className += currentSort.desc
      ? ' sorted-desc'
      : ' sorted';
  }
  // adds event listeners for all sorter widgets
  function enableUI() {
    var i,
      el,
      ithSorter = function ithSorter(i) {
        var col = cols[i];

        return function () {
          var desc = col.defaultDescSort;

          if (currentSort.index === i) {
            desc = !currentSort.desc;
          }
          sortByIndex(i, desc);
          removeSortIndicators();
          currentSort.index = i;
          currentSort.desc = desc;
          addSortIndicators();
        };
      };
    for (i = 0; i < cols.length; i += 1) {
      if (cols[i].sortable) {
        // add the click event handler on the th so users
        // dont have to click on those tiny arrows
        el = getNthColumn(i).querySelector('.sorter').parentElement;
        if (el.addEventListener) {
          el.addEventListener('click', ithSorter(i));
        } else {
          el.attachEvent('onclick', ithSorter(i));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // adds sorting functionality to the UI
  return function () {
    if (!getTable()) {
      return;
    }
    cols = loadColumns();
    loadData();
    addSearchBox();
    addSortIndicators();
    enableUI();
  };
})();

window.addEventListener('load', addSorting);
```

```html
<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  Image,
  FlatList,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StatusBar,
  Dimensions,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import {
  useRoute,
  RouteProp,
  useFocusEffect,
  useNavigation,
} from '@react-navigation/native';
import { NativeStackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';
import { supabase } from '../../services/supabase';
import type { AppStackParamList } from '../../navigation/types';
import { styles } from './style';
import ReviewModal from '../../components/ReviewModal';
import LoadingScreen from '../../components/LoadingScreen';
import Toast from '../../components/Toast';
import { useToast } from '../../hooks/useToast';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
&nbsp;
type ProviderProfile = {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  avatar_url: string;
};
&nbsp;
type ReviewData = {
  id: number;
  rating: number;
  comment: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  profiles: { full_name: string; avatar_url: string } | null;
};
&nbsp;
type ServiceDetails = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  price: number | null;
  photo_urls: string[] | null;
  availability: string | null;
  profiles: ProviderProfile | null;
  categories: { name: string } | null;
  reviews: ReviewData[];
};
&nbsp;
type ServiceDetailRouteProp = RouteProp&lt;AppStackParamList, 'ServiceDetail'&gt;;
type ServiceDetailNavigationProp = NativeStackNavigationProp&lt;AppStackParamList&gt;;
&nbsp;
/**
 * Hook para gerenciar dados e ações do serviço
 */
const useServiceDetails = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(s</span>erviceId: number) =&gt; {</span>
  const navigation = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useNavigation&lt;ServiceDetailNavigationProp&gt;();</span>
  const { showToast, toastProps } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useToast();</span>
  const [service, setService] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState&lt;ServiceDetails | null&gt;(null);</span>
  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(true);</span>
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
  const fetchServiceDetails = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useCallback(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!serviceId) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const { data, error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase</span>
        .from('services')
        .select(
          `*, profiles(*), categories(name), reviews(id, rating, comment, created_at, profiles(full_name, avatar_url))`,
        )
        .eq('id', serviceId)
        .single();
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setService(data as ServiceDetails);</span>
    } catch (error) {
      const message =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>
          ? error.message
          : 'Não foi possível carregar os detalhes.';
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast(message, 'error');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigation.goBack();</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
    }
  }, [serviceId, navigation, showToast]);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useFocusEffect(</span>
    useCallback(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      fetchServiceDetails();</span>
    }, [fetchServiceDetails]),
  );
&nbsp;
  const handleSubmitReview = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync (rating: number, comment: string) =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (!user) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw new Error('Você precisa estar logado para avaliar.');</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (user.id === service?.profiles?.id) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        showToast('Você não pode avaliar o seu próprio serviço', 'warning');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const { error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase</span>
        .from('reviews')
        .insert({ service_id: serviceId, user_id: user.id, rating, comment });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast('Avaliação enviada com sucesso!', 'success');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      fetchServiceDetails();</span>
    } catch (error) {
      const message =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>
          ? error.message
          : 'Ocorreu um erro desconhecido.';
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast(message, 'error');</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleStartConversation = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!service?.profiles?.id) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setActionLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (!user) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        showToast(</span>
          'Você precisa estar logado para iniciar uma conversa',
          'error',
        );
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (user.id === service.profiles.id) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        showToast('Você não pode conversar consigo mesmo', 'warning');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const { data: conversationId, error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.rpc(</span>
        'get_or_create_conversation',
        {
          participant1_id_input: user.id,
          participant2_id_input: service.profiles.id,
        },
      );
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (conversationId &amp;&amp; service.profiles) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        navigation.navigate('Chat', {</span>
          conversationId,
          recipient: service.profiles,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const message =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>
          ? error.message
          : 'Ocorreu um erro desconhecido.';
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast(message, 'error');</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setActionLoading(false);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return {</span>
    service,
    loading,
    actionLoading,
    handleSubmitReview,
    handleStartConversation,
    toastProps,
  };
};
&nbsp;
/**
 * Componente de review individual
 */
const ReviewItem: React.FC&lt;{ review: ReviewData }&gt; = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >({</span> review }) =&gt; {</span>
  const timeAgo = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(d</span>ateString: string) =&gt; {</span>
    const now = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new Date();</span>
    const reviewDate = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >new Date(dateString);</span>
    const diffInMs = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >now.getTime() - reviewDate.getTime();</span>
    const diffInDays = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.floor(diffInMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (diffInDays === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 'Hoje';</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (diffInDays === 1) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 'Ontem';</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (diffInDays &lt; 7) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return `${diffInDays} dias atrás`;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (diffInDays &lt; 30) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return `${Math.floor(diffInDays / 7)} semanas atrás`;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (diffInDays &lt; 365) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return `${Math.floor(diffInDays / 30)} meses atrás`;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return `${Math.floor(diffInDays / 365)} anos atrás`;</span>
  };
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
    &lt;View style={styles.reviewItem}&gt;
      &lt;View style={styles.reviewHeader}&gt;
        &lt;Image

          &lt;Text style={styles.reviewAuthor}&gt;

          &lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.reviewDate}&gt;{timeAgo(review.created_at)}&lt;/Text&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;View style={styles.reviewStars}&gt;
          {[...Array(5)].map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(_</span>, i) =&gt; (
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            &lt;Ionicons</span>
              key={i}
              name="star"
              size={14}
              color={i &lt; review.rating ? '#F59E0B' : '#E5E7EB'}
            /&gt;
          ))}
        &lt;/View&gt;
      &lt;/View&gt;
      {review.comment &amp;&amp; (
        &lt;Text style={styles.reviewComment}&gt;{review.comment}&lt;/Text&gt;
      )}
    &lt;/View&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
/**

 */
const ServiceDetailScreen: React.FC = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (loading) {</span>

&nbsp;
  const averageRating =

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                  &lt;Ionicons</span>
                    key={i}
                    name="star"
                    size={18}
                    color={
                      i &lt; Math.round(averageRating) ? '#F59E0B' : '#E5E7EB'
                    }
                  /&gt;
                ))}
              &lt;/View&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.ratingText}&gt;
                {averageRating.toFixed(1)} ({service.reviews.length}{' '}
                {service.reviews.length === 1 ? 'avaliação' : 'avaliações'})
              &lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
          )}
&nbsp;
          {/* Provider Card */}
          &lt;View style={styles.providerContainer}&gt;
            &lt;Image
              source={{
                uri:
                  service.profiles?.avatar_url ||
                  'https://via.placeholder.com/50',
              }}
              style={styles.providerAvatar}
            /&gt;
            &lt;View style={styles.providerInfo}&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.providerLabel}&gt;Oferecido por&lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.providerName}&gt;
                {service.profiles?.full_name || 'Usuário Anônimo'}
              &lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
            &lt;Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={20} color="#9CA3AF" /&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
        {/* Descrição */}
        &lt;View style={styles.section}&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.sectionTitle}&gt;Sobre o serviço&lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.description}&gt;
            {service.description || 'Nenhuma descrição fornecida.'}
          &lt;/Text&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
        {/* Disponibilidade */}
        {service.availability &amp;&amp; (
          &lt;View style={styles.section}&gt;
            &lt;Text style={styles.sectionTitle}&gt;Disponibilidade&lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;View style={styles.availabilityCard}&gt;
              &lt;Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={20} color="#3B82F6" /&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.availabilityText}&gt;
                {service.availability}
              &lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
        )}
&nbsp;
        {/* Avaliações */}
        &lt;View style={styles.section}&gt;
          &lt;View style={styles.reviewsHeader}&gt;
            &lt;Text style={styles.sectionTitle}&gt;
              Avaliações{' '}
              {service.reviews.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; `(${service.reviews.length})`}
            &lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.addReviewButton}
              onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setReviewModalVisible(true)}</span>
            &gt;
              &lt;Ionicons name="add-circle" size={20} color="#3B82F6" /&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.addReviewButtonText}&gt;Avaliar&lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
          {service.reviews &amp;&amp; service.reviews.length &gt; 0 ? (
            service.reviews.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >re</span>view =&gt; (
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >              &lt;ReviewItem key={review.id} review={review} /&gt;</span>
            ))
          ) : (
            &lt;View style={styles.noReviewsContainer}&gt;
              &lt;Ionicons name="star-outline" size={48} color="#D1D5DB" /&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.noReviewsText}&gt;
                Seja o primeiro a avaliar este serviço!
              &lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
          )}
        &lt;/View&gt;
      &lt;/ScrollView&gt;
&nbsp;
      {/* Footer Fixo */}
      &lt;View style={styles.footer}&gt;
        &lt;View style={styles.priceContainer}&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.priceLabel}&gt;A partir de&lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.priceValue}&gt;
            {service.price !== null
              ? `R$ ${service.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`
              : 'A combinar'}
          &lt;/Text&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            styles.actionButton,
            actionLoading &amp;&amp; styles.actionButtonDisabled,
          ]}
          onPress={handleStartConversation}
          disabled={actionLoading}
        &gt;
          {actionLoading ? (
            &lt;Ionicons name="hourglass-outline" size={20} color="#FFFFFF" /&gt;
          ) : (
            &lt;Ionicons name="chatbubble-ellipses" size={20} color="#FFFFFF" /&gt;
          )}
          &lt;Text style={styles.actionButtonText}&gt;
            {actionLoading ? 'Aguarde...' : 'Pedir Orçamento'}
          &lt;/Text&gt;
        &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
      &lt;/View&gt;
    &lt;/SafeAreaView&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
export default ServiceDetailScreen;
&nbsp;</pre></td></tr></table></pre>
```

```html
&nbsp;
```
```html
          const { data, error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase</span>

&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          if (error &amp;&amp; error.code !== 'PGRST116') <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
&nbsp;

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            setProfile({</span>
```

```html
<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  SafeAreaView,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  StatusBar,
} from 'react-native';
import { useRoute, RouteProp } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { supabase } from '../../services/supabase';
import { styles } from './style';
import type { AuthStackParamList } from '../../navigation/types';
&nbsp;
type ConfirmEmailRouteProp = RouteProp&lt;AuthStackParamList, 'ConfirmEmail'&gt;;
const COOLDOWN_SECONDS = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >60;</span>
&nbsp;
/**
 * Hook customizado para gerenciar um contador regressivo.
 * @param initialCount O número inicial de segundos para a contagem.
 * @returns Um objeto com o tempo restante e uma função para reiniciar o contador.
 */
const useCountdown = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(i</span>nitialCount: number) =&gt; {</span>
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(initialCount);</span>
  const isRunning = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >countdown &gt; 0;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useEffect(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!isRunning) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return;</span></span>
&nbsp;
    const timerId = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setInterval(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setCountdown(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >cu</span>rrent =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >current - 1)</span>;</span>
    }, 1000);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >clearInterval(timerId);</span></span>
  }, [isRunning]);
&nbsp;
  const resetCountdown = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setCountdown(initialCount);</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return { countdown, isRunning, resetCountdown };</span>
};
&nbsp;
/**
 * Tela para o usuário inserir o código de verificação (OTP) enviado para seu e-mail.
 */
const ConfirmEmailScreen: React.FC = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
  const route = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useRoute&lt;ConfirmEmailRouteProp&gt;();</span>
  const { email } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >route.params;</span>
&nbsp;
  const [otp, setOtp] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
  const [error, setError] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [resendStatus, setResendStatus] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const { countdown, isRunning, resetCountdown } =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    useCountdown(COOLDOWN_SECONDS);</span>
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Valida e envia o código OTP para o Supabase para verificação.
   */
  const handleConfirmOtp = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setError('');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (otp.length !== 6) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setError('O código deve ter 6 dígitos.');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
    }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
    const { error: verifyError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({</span>
      email: email,
      token: otp,
      type: 'signup',
    });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (verifyError) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setError('Código inválido ou expirado. Tente novamente.');</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(false);</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Solicita o reenvio de um novo código OTP para o e-mail do usuário.
   */
  const handleResendOtp = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (isRunning || loading) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setResendStatus('');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setError('');</span>
&nbsp;
    const { error: resendError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.resend({</span>
      type: 'signup',
      email: email,
    });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (resendError) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setError('Ocorreu um erro ao reenviar o código.');</span>
    } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setResendStatus('Um novo código foi enviado para seu e-mail.');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      resetCountdown(); </span>// Reinicia o contador
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(false);</span>
  };
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
    &lt;SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}&gt;
      &lt;StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" /&gt;
      &lt;KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.keyboardAvoidingContainer}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}
      &gt;
        &lt;View style={styles.contentContainer}&gt;
          &lt;Ionicons
            name="mail-open-outline"
            size={80}
            color="#3F83F8"
            style={styles.icon}
          /&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.title}&gt;Verifique seu E-mail&lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;Text style={styles.message}&gt;
            Enviamos um código de 6 dígitos para {email}. Por favor, insira-o
            abaixo.
          &lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;TextInput
            style={styles.otpInput}
            value={otp}
            onChangeText={setOtp}
            keyboardType="number-pad"
            maxLength={6}
            placeholder="------"
            placeholderTextColor="#CBD5E0"
          /&gt;
&nbsp;
          {error ? &lt;Text style={styles.errorText}&gt;{error}&lt;/Text&gt; : null}
&nbsp;
          &lt;TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.button}
            onPress={handleConfirmOtp}
            disabled={loading}
          &gt;
            {loading ? (
              &lt;ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" /&gt;
            ) : (
              &lt;Text style={styles.buttonText}&gt;Confirmar e Continuar&lt;/Text&gt;
            )}
          &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
&nbsp;
          &lt;View style={styles.resendContainer}&gt;
            {!isRunning ? (
              &lt;TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.resendButton}
                onPress={handleResendOtp}
                disabled={loading}
              &gt;
                &lt;Text style={styles.resendButtonText}&gt;
                  Não recebeu? Reenviar código
                &lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
            ) : (
              &lt;Text style={styles.resendText}&gt;
                Você pode reenviar o código em {countdown} segundos
              &lt;/Text&gt;
            )}
            {resendStatus ? (
              &lt;Text style={styles.resendStatusText}&gt;{resendStatus}&lt;/Text&gt;
            ) : null}
          &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
      &lt;/KeyboardAvoidingView&gt;
    &lt;/SafeAreaView&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
export default ConfirmEmailScreen;
&nbsp;</pre></td></tr></table></pre>
```

```html
<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  StatusBar,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { NativeStackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { supabase } from '../../services/supabase';
import { styles } from './style';
import Toast from '../../components/Toast';
import { useToast } from '../../hooks/useToast';
import type { AuthStackParamList } from '../../navigation/types';
&nbsp;
type LoginScreenNavigationProp = NativeStackNavigationProp&lt;
  AuthStackParamList,
  'Login'
&gt;;
&nbsp;
/**
 * Tela de Login com validação e feedback visual
 */
const LoginScreen: React.FC = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
  const navigation = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useNavigation&lt;LoginScreenNavigationProp&gt;();</span>
  const { showToast, toastProps } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useToast();</span>
&nbsp;
  const [email, setEmail] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [password, setPassword] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [isPasswordVisible, setIsPasswordVisible] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
  // Validation states
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
&nbsp;
  const validateEmail = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(e</span>mail: string): boolean =&gt; {</span>
    const emailRegex = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!email.trim()) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setEmailError('E-mail é obrigatório');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return false;</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setEmailError('E-mail inválido');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return false;</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setEmailError('');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return true;</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  const validatePassword = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(p</span>assword: string): boolean =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!password) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setPasswordError('Senha é obrigatória');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return false;</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (password.length &lt; 6) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setPasswordError('Senha deve ter no mínimo 6 caracteres');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return false;</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setPasswordError('');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return true;</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  const handleLogin = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
    const isEmailValid = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >validateEmail(email);</span>
    const isPasswordValid = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >validatePassword(password);</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!isEmailValid || !isPasswordValid) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast('Por favor, corrija os erros no formulário', 'error');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
    }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const { error: signInError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({</span>
        email: email.trim(),
        password: password,
      });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (signInError) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (signInError.message === 'Email not confirmed') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          showToast(</span>
            'Por favor, confirme seu e-mail antes de fazer login',
            'warning',
          );
        } else <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >if (signInError.message.includes('Invalid login credentials')) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          showToast('E-mail ou senha incorretos', 'error');</span>
        } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          showToast(signInError.message, 'error');</span>
        }
      } else {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        showToast('Login realizado com sucesso!', 'success');</span>
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const message =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erro ao fazer login';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      showToast(message, 'error');</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
    &lt;SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}&gt;
      &lt;StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" /&gt;
      &lt;Toast {...toastProps} /&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}
      &gt;
        &lt;ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContainer}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        &gt;
          {/* Header */}
          &lt;View style={styles.headerContainer}&gt;
            &lt;View style={styles.iconContainer}&gt;
              &lt;Ionicons name="log-in" size={48} color="#3B82F6" /&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
            &lt;Text style={styles.title}&gt;Bem-vindo de volta!&lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;Text style={styles.subtitle}&gt;
              Entre com sua conta para continuar
            &lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
          {/* Form */}
          &lt;View style={styles.formContainer}&gt;
            &lt;View style={styles.inputWrapper}&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.label}&gt;E-mail&lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;View
                style={[
                  styles.inputContainer,
                  emailError ? styles.inputContainerError : null,
                ]}
              &gt;
                &lt;Ionicons
                  name="mail-outline"
                  size={20}
                  color={emailError ? '#EF4444' : '#64748B'}
                /&gt;
                &lt;TextInput
                  style={styles.input}
                  placeholder="seu@email.com"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94A3B8"
                  value={email}
                  onChangeText={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >te</span>xt =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                    setEmail(text);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                    setEmailError('');</span>
                  }}
                  onBlur={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >validateEmail(email)}</span>
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                /&gt;
              &lt;/View&gt;
              {emailError ? (
                &lt;Text style={styles.errorText}&gt;{emailError}&lt;/Text&gt;
              ) : null}
            &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
            &lt;View style={styles.inputWrapper}&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.label}&gt;Senha&lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;View
                style={[
                  styles.inputContainer,
                  passwordError ? styles.inputContainerError : null,
                ]}
              &gt;
                &lt;Ionicons
                  name="lock-closed-outline"
                  size={20}
                  color={passwordError ? '#EF4444' : '#64748B'}
                /&gt;
                &lt;TextInput
                  style={styles.input}
                  placeholder="Sua senha"
                  placeholderTextColor="#94A3B8"
                  value={password}
                  onChangeText={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >te</span>xt =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                    setPassword(text);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                    setPasswordError('');</span>
                  }}
                  onBlur={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >validatePassword(password)}</span>
                  secureTextEntry={!isPasswordVisible}
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                /&gt;
                &lt;TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setIsPasswordVisible(!isPasswordVisible)}</span>
                &gt;
                  &lt;Ionicons
                    name={isPasswordVisible ? 'eye-off-outline' : 'eye-outline'}
                    size={20}
                    color="#64748B"
                  /&gt;
                &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
              &lt;/View&gt;
              {passwordError ? (
                &lt;Text style={styles.errorText}&gt;{passwordError}&lt;/Text&gt;
              ) : null}
            &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
            &lt;TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.forgotPasswordButton}
              onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >navigation.navigate('ForgotPassword')}</span>
            &gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.forgotPasswordText}&gt;Esqueceu a senha?&lt;/Text&gt;
            &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
&nbsp;
          {/* Actions */}
          &lt;View style={styles.footerContainer}&gt;
            &lt;TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.loginButton,
                loading &amp;&amp; styles.loginButtonDisabled,
              ]}
              onPress={handleLogin}
              disabled={loading}
            &gt;
              {loading ? (
                &lt;ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" /&gt;
              ) : (
                &lt;&gt;
                  &lt;Text style={styles.loginButtonText}&gt;Entrar&lt;/Text&gt;
                  &lt;Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={20} color="#FFFFFF" /&gt;
                &lt;/&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
&nbsp;
            &lt;View style={styles.signupContainer}&gt;
              &lt;Text style={styles.signupText}&gt;Não tem uma conta? &lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;TouchableOpacity onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >navigation.navigate('Register')}</span>&gt;
                &lt;Text style={styles.signupLink}&gt;Cadastre-se&lt;/Text&gt;
              &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
            &lt;/View&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;/ScrollView&gt;
      &lt;/KeyboardAvoidingView&gt;
    &lt;/SafeAreaView&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
export default LoginScreen;
```

```html
&nbsp;
```
```html
/**
```

```html
 */
type Conversation = {
  id: number;
  other_participant_id: string;

  last_message_content: string | null;
  last_message_at: string | null;
};
type ConversationsNavigationProp = NativeStackNavigationProp&lt;AppStackParamList&gt;;
&nbsp;
/**

 */
const useConversations = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>

  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(true);</span>
&nbsp;
  const fetchConversations = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useCallback(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const { data, error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.rpc('get_user_conversations');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setConversations(data || []);</span>
    } catch (error) {

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      Alert.alert('Erro ao carregar conversas', message);</span>
    }
  }, []);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  useFocusEffect(</span>
    useCallback(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      fetchConversations().finally(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setLoading(false))</span>;</span>
    }, [fetchConversations]),
  );
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  React.useEffect(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
    const channel = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >supabase</span>
      .channel('public:messages')

<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >        ()</span> =&gt; {

        },

      .subscribe();
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      supabase.removeChannel(channel);</span>
    };
  }, [fetchConversations]);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return { conversations, loading };</span>
};
&nbsp;
/**
 * Tela que exibe a lista de conversas ativas do usuário.
 */
const ConversationsScreen = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>

&nbsp;

    const recipient: RecipientProfile = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >{</span>
      id: item.other_participant_id,

    };
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return (</span>
      &lt;TouchableOpacity
        style={styles.conversationItem}
        onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >          navigation.navigate('Chat', {</span>

        &lt;/View&gt;
        {item.last_message_at &amp;&amp; (

&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  if (loading) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return &lt;ActivityIndicator style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center' }} /&gt;;</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
```

```html
<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import React, { useState } from 'react';
```
```html
import {

  TextInput,
```

```html
  SafeAreaView,

} from 'react-native';
import MaskInput from 'react-native-mask-input';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { decode } from 'base64-arraybuffer';
import { supabase } from '../../services/supabase';
import LocationSelectorModal from '../../components/LocationSelectorModal';
import { styles } from './style';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { NativeStackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';
// CORREÇÃO: Importação do tipo do arquivo central 'types'
import type { AppStackParamList } from '../../navigation/types';
&nbsp;
type NavigationProp = NativeStackNavigationProp&lt;
  AppStackParamList,
  'CompleteProfile'
&gt;;
&nbsp;
/**
 * Tela de "Completar Cadastro" (Onboarding).
 * Coleta informações essenciais do perfil do usuário, como nome, telefone,
 * localização e foto, após a confirmação do e-mail inicial.
 */
const CompleteProfileScreen: React.FC = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
  const navigation = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useNavigation&lt;NavigationProp&gt;();</span>
&nbsp;
  const [fullName, setFullName] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [phone, setPhone] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [location, setLocation] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);</span>
  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
  const [isLocationModalVisible, setLocationModalVisible] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Lida com a seleção de uma imagem de avatar, seja da câmera ou da galeria.
   * @param source Define a origem da imagem ('camera' ou 'gallery').
   */
  const handleAvatarSelection = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync (source: 'camera' | 'gallery') =&gt; {</span>
    const options: ImagePicker.ImagePickerOptions = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >{</span>
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsEditing: true,
      aspect: [1, 1],
      quality: 0.7,
      base64: true,
    };
&nbsp;
    let result;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (source === 'camera') {</span>
      const { status } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await ImagePicker.requestCameraPermissionsAsync();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (status !== 'granted') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        Alert.alert(</span>
          'Permissão negada',
          'Precisamos de acesso à câmera para tirar uma foto.',
        );
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      result = await ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync(options);</span>
    } else {
      const { status } =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (status !== 'granted') {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        Alert.alert(</span>
          'Permissão negada',
          'Precisamos de acesso à galeria para escolher uma foto.',
        );
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync(options);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!result.canceled &amp;&amp; result.assets &amp;&amp; result.assets[0].base64) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      uploadAvatar(result.assets[0].base64);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Faz o upload da imagem do avatar para o Supabase Storage e atualiza o perfil.
   * @param base64 A imagem codificada em base64.
   */
  const uploadAvatar = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync (base64: string) =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (!user) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw new Error('Usuário não encontrado');</span></span>
&nbsp;
      const filePath = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >`${user.id}/${new Date().getTime()}.png`;</span>
      const imageBuffer = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >decode(base64);</span>
&nbsp;
      const { error: uploadError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.storage</span>
        .from('avatars')
        .upload(filePath, imageBuffer, { contentType: 'image/png' });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (uploadError) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw uploadError;</span></span>
&nbsp;
      const { data: publicUrlData } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >supabase.storage</span>
        .from('avatars')
        .getPublicUrl(filePath);
      const publicUrl = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >`${publicUrlData.publicUrl}?t=${new Date().getTime()}`;</span> // Cache busting
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setAvatarUrl(publicUrl);</span>
&nbsp;
      const { error: updateError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase</span>
        .from('profiles')
        .update({ avatar_url: publicUrl })
        .eq('id', user.id);
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (updateError) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw updateError;</span></span>
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMessage =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>
          ? error.message
          : 'Ocorreu um erro desconhecido.';
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      Alert.alert('Erro no upload', errorMessage);</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Valida e salva as informações do perfil no banco de dados.
   * Em caso de sucesso, reseta a navegação para a tela principal do app.
   */
  const handleCompleteProfile = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!fullName.trim() || !phone || !location) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      Alert.alert(</span>
        'Campos obrigatórios',
        'Por favor, preencha todas as informações para continuar.',
      );
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
    }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (!user) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw new Error('Usuário não autenticado.');</span></span>
&nbsp;
      const updates = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >{</span>
        id: user.id,
        full_name: fullName.trim(),
        phone,
        location,
        updated_at: new Date(),
      };
&nbsp;
      const { error } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase</span>
        .from('profiles')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', user.id);
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (error) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw error;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigation.reset({</span>
        index: 0,
        routes: [{ name: 'MainTabs' }],
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMessage =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        error instanceof Error</span>
          ? error.message
          : 'Ocorreu um erro desconhecido.';
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      Alert.alert('Erro ao salvar perfil', errorMessage);</span>
    } finally {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
    }
  };
&nbsp;
  const showImagePickerOptions = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    Alert.alert('Adicionar Foto', 'Escolha uma opção', [</span>
      { text: 'Tirar Foto', onPress: <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >handleAvatarSelection('camera') </span>},
      {
        text: 'Escolher da Galeria',
        onPress: <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >handleAvatarSelection('gallery'),</span>
      },
```

```html
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!password) {</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      navigation.reset({ index: 0, routes: [{ name: 'Login' }] });</span>
```

```html
<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  SafeAreaView,
  Modal,
  ActivityIndicator,
  TextInputProps,
} from 'react-native';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { supabase } from '../../services/supabase';
import { styles } from './style';
&nbsp;
interface PasswordInputProps extends TextInputProps {
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (text: string) =&gt; void;
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Um componente de input de senha reutilizável com um ícone para alternar a visibilidade.
 */
const PasswordInput: React.FC&lt;PasswordInputProps&gt; = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >({</span></span>
  value,
  onChangeText,
  ...props
}) =&gt; {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>
    &lt;View style={styles.inputContainer}&gt;
      &lt;TextInput
        style={styles.input}
        value={value}
        onChangeText={onChangeText}
        secureTextEntry={!isVisible}
        autoCapitalize="none"
        {...props}
      /&gt;
      &lt;TouchableOpacity
        onPress={<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >setIsVisible(!isVisible)}</span>
        style={styles.icon}
      &gt;
        &lt;Ionicons name={isVisible ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} size={24} color="gray" /&gt;
      &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
    &lt;/View&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
// --- Componente Principal ---
&nbsp;
/**
 * Tela que permite ao usuário alterar sua senha.
 * O usuário deve fornecer a senha atual e uma nova senha (com confirmação).
 */
const ChangePasswordScreen = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
  const navigation = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useNavigation();</span>
&nbsp;
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [confirmNewPassword, setConfirmNewPassword] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [loading, setLoading] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
  const [error, setError] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState('');</span>
  const [showSuccessModal, setShowSuccessModal] = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >useState(false);</span>
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Valida as senhas inseridas pelo usuário.
   * @returns Uma string de erro se a validação falhar, caso contrário, null.
   */
  const validatePasswords = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span>: string | null =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!currentPassword || !newPassword || !confirmNewPassword) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return 'Todos os campos são obrigatórios.';</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (newPassword.length &lt; 6) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return 'A nova senha deve ter no mínimo 6 caracteres.';</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (newPassword !== confirmNewPassword) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return 'As novas senhas não coincidem.';</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return null;</span>
  };
&nbsp;
  /**
   * Orquestra o processo de alteração de senha, incluindo validação e chamadas à API.
   */
  const handleChangePassword = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >as</span>ync () =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setError('');</span>
    const validationError = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >validatePasswords();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (validationError) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setError(validationError);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      return;</span>
    }
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    setLoading(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    try {</span>
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.getUser();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (!user?.email)</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        throw new Error(</span>
          'Usuário não autenticado. Por favor, faça login novamente.',
        );
&nbsp;
      // Verifica se a senha atual está correta tentando fazer login com ela
      const { error: signInError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({</span>
        email: user.email,
        password: currentPassword,
      });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (signInError) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setError('A senha atual está incorreta.');</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return;</span>
      }
&nbsp;
      const { error: updateError } = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >await supabase.auth.updateUser({</span>
        password: newPassword,
      });
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      if (updateError) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >throw updateError;</span></span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setShowSuccessModal(true);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setTimeout(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >()</span> =&gt; {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        setShowSuccessModal(false);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        navigation.goBack();</span>
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage =
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ocorreu um erro desconhecido.';</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setError(errorMessage);</span>

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >      setLoading(false);</span>
    }
  };

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >  return (</span>

        &lt;View style={styles.modalContainer}&gt;
          &lt;View style={styles.modalView}&gt;
            &lt;Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={80} color="#48BB78" /&gt;
            &lt;Text style={styles.modalText}&gt;Senha Alterada!&lt;/Text&gt;
          &lt;/View&gt;
        &lt;/View&gt;
      &lt;/Modal&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;Text style={styles.headerText}&gt;
        Sua senha precisa ter no mínimo 6 caracteres para sua segurança.
      &lt;/Text&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;PasswordInput
        placeholder="Senha atual"
        value={currentPassword}
        onChangeText={setCurrentPassword}
      /&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;PasswordInput
        placeholder="Nova senha"
        value={newPassword}
        onChangeText={setNewPassword}
      /&gt;
&nbsp;
      &lt;PasswordInput

      /&gt;
&nbsp;
      {error ? &lt;Text style={styles.errorText}&gt;{error}&lt;/Text&gt; : null}
&nbsp;
      &lt;TouchableOpacity
        style={[styles.button, loading &amp;&amp; styles.buttonDisabled]}

        disabled={loading}
      &gt;
        {loading ? (

        ) : (
          &lt;Text style={styles.buttonText}&gt;Confirmar alteração&lt;/Text&gt;
        )}
      &lt;/TouchableOpacity&gt;
    &lt;/SafeAreaView&gt;
  );
};
&nbsp;
export default ChangePasswordScreen;
```
